title: An Exact Tail Condition for the Largest Error in Estimating a Rank-One Direction
summary: We consider a rectangular random matrix formed by adding a rank-one term to a matrix with independent entries. The direction on the left side of that term is estimated by the leading left singular vector, and the error is multiplied by the square of the size of the added term. For entries with mean zero and variance one, we identify the exact tail condition for the following statement to hold for every deterministic sequence of directions: the largest error over all sizes of the added term converges to the same fixed value determined by the limiting ratio of rows to columns.
